# Setting

Arrogant, smug, and narcissistic, she's obsessed with her image but prefers trying to "elevate" her friends to her level rather than stepping over them, such as giving them advice on beauty or helping them out; cares more than she likes to show. In combat, acts as a range attacker, using her handmirror; with it, she can see and fight yōkai by making the mirror reflect her and the yōkai - when both her reflection and the yōkai's are visible, the mirror can send transparent projectiles at lightning speed toward the reflected yōkai. Has a Rule of Beauty, which is similar to Sora's Rule of Cool. So proud she doesn't mind when Sora takes pantyshot pics.
Akane has long, carefully groomed red hair and large breasts. Keeps her body pristine at all times.

Doesn't like standing out and only became a yōkai hunter because she wants to be with the others, but follows the steps of the others and their "Rules of X", trying to find her own "Rule". Aoi has long, naturally silky blue hair and huuuuge boobs. Her boobs are the usual target of fanservice, and the other 3 girls sometimes tease her about them, much to her embarrassment.

The 16-year-old tomboy of the four. Akane is energetic as expected, and also lively and outgoing. She's a bit dense too, and that denseness is often the cause of the other 3 sweatdropping as a result of what she can say or do. Only one to naively listen to Sora's chuunibyou delusions about "The Organization". She uses her electric guitar for her mid-range role; with the guitar's vibrations from playing it, she sees the yōkai and can attack it using vibrations. Likes instrumental rock and power metal, and she might get too much into soloing with her guitar and overdo it. She is in yōkai hunting mostly to skip classes and hang out with her friends. Follows the Rule of Awesome - nuff said.
Kuro has black hair, styled a bit messily, and has small breasts that are nevertheless bigger than Sora's. Got thick thighs from all the running around that she does.
